dedup_policy: Only proven same contracts/control cases are folded. Different native owner/direct/causer, ammo, amount, recipient, reflection, phase, scheduling, persistence or callback route remains distinct. Source-only block variants share a delivery but remain named. Every original case survives in the immutable archive and total disposition/fixture matrix.
